messages:
alex: evening check-in — dropping off now. Canary run is on node-gpu-4 but we've seen 502 spike on long-request tests. I reverted the config to the previous batch-size (32 -> 16) and restarted the canary.

maria: thanks alex. any logs? can you paste the quick curl or ps output?

alex: paste:
```
kubectl -n prod logs pod/canary-rls-42 | tail -n 100
```
saw repeated "kv cache oom" and "inference: request timeout 10s".

sam_dev: I'm on it, will try a quick restart with kv cache trim and smaller max_seq.

jen_ops: heads up — if canary keeps flaking, we'll abort and roll fallback to v2.1.0. Who owns the PR with the batching change?

alex: PR is #4321 — small change in serving/runtime/batcher.cc. @sam_dev can you review? link: https://phabricator.redwood/4321

sam_dev: Skimmed — LGTM but will run unit. If it passes I'll merge and trigger staging canary.

release-bot: deploy canary to cluster-prod-us-east triggered by alex at 2026-03-17T21:09:10Z — canary-id rls-canary-20260317-8

maria: if merge blocked ping me, I can fast-track.

alex: merging now. also leaving notes in the PR re: reverting if 502 persists. I'll be on call for next 30m.

sam_dev: merged, running smoke tests. If smoke passes, I'll promote to canary. :crossed_fingers:

jen_ops: good. if canary fails twice in 15m we abort — set rollback window to 20m.

release-bot: canary rls-canary-20260317-8 smoke status: failed (1/3 flaky tests) — logs: https://logs.redwood/canary/rls-canary-20260317-8

maria: ok aborting per policy. initiating rollback.

alex: confirmed rollback started. leaving handoff for night-owl oncall — @maria please take over if it spikes again. good night team :coffee:

maria: taking over, will watch next hour and report back.
